scope: 菲律宾境内销售的小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码：通用广告与消费者保护、价格标示与比较价格、标签与语言、电气产品强制认证（PS/ICC）、互联网交易披露、隐私告知。食品/美妆/玩具/药品等品类特殊规则、支付/物流/退换（Layer 3）不在本版范围。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在“法条原文 + 页面原文”同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403，未能逐字比对政府站点。
rules.requirement: 不得散布或促使散布虚假、欺骗性或误导性广告（印刷、广播、电视、户外或其他媒介），包括就产品作出不实陈述或未披露重要事实；是否误导按整体印象、语境与重要事实判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（桌面/移动）、投放渠道与时间、声称所依据的测试/认证文件、同类表述的历史版本、重要事实是否在购买决策前披露。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 123(a)：罚款 ₱500–₱5,000 和/或 1–6 个月监禁（法院裁量）；行政制裁另见 Art. 164（停止令、行政罚款 ₱500–₱300,000 等）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It shall be unlawful for any person to disseminate or to cause the dissemination of any false, deceptive or misleading advertisement by Philippine mail or in commerce by print, radio, television, outdoor advertisement or other medium for the purpose of inducing or which is likely to induce directly or indirectly the purchase of consumer products or services.
rules.notes: 广告章节的兜底条款；不凭词表单独下结论。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务具有其实际并不具有的赞助、批准、性能、特征、成分、配件、用途或收益；判断以页面整体陈述与可核实事实为准。
rules.evidence_needed: 声称所依据的批准/认证/测试文件、授权方名单、性能测试报告、页面截图与投放时间。
rules.penalty_or_note: Title III 未设刑事罚则；DTI 可依 Art. 164 发出停止令、接受整改承诺、责令退款/召回并处以行政罚款（₱500–₱300,000，另加每日不超过 ₱1,000）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: a consumer product or service has the sponsorship, approval, performance, characteristics, ingredients, accessories, uses, or benefits it does not have;
rules.notes: Art. 50 的列举不穷尽；仍需结合 Art. 110 的广告总则。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务达到某一特定标准、品质、等级、款式或型号，而事实上并非如此。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品规格书、对应的 PNS/国际标准号、检测报告、型号与版本记录、页面截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: Title III 未设刑事罚则；DTI 可依 Art. 164 处以行政制裁（停止令、行政罚款 ₱500–₱300,000 等）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: a consumer product or service is of a particular standard, quality, grade, style, or model when in fact it is not;
rules.notes: “standard”在页面里也可能指“标准配置”，需看上下文，避免把普通形容词当合规声称。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品存在特定价格优势，而事实上并不存在；比较价格还须满足 Art. 111 的基准要求。
rules.evidence_needed: 该 SKU 的历史售价与成交记录、促销排期、比较基准（原价/SRP/竞品价）的定义与来源。
rules.penalty_or_note: Title III 未设刑事罚则；DTI 可依 Art. 164 处以行政制裁；若构成广告违规，另见 Art. 123(a)。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: a specific price advantage of a consumer product exists when in fact it does not;
rules.notes: 与 PH-ADV-05 配套使用：先看是否有价格优势陈述，再核对 90 天/4 周基准。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 比较广告若以卖家“原价/过去价”为基准，该商品须在广告前 90 天内以该价格实际售出，或在 90 天内至少 4 周以该价格要约销售；否则须披露该价格的时间/季节区间。
rules.evidence_needed: 价格历史（含成交，不只是标价）、促销起止日期、后台价格字段、同款在其他 PH 渠道的售价。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 123(a)：罚款 ₱500–₱5,000 和/或 1–6 个月监禁；行政制裁另见 Art. 164。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where the comparison relates to a former price of the seller, the item compared shall either have been sold at that price within the ninety (90) days immediately preceding the date of the advertisement, or it shall have been offered for sale for at least four (4) weeks during such ninety-day period.
rules.notes: PH 少见的成文比较价格规则；与 SRP 比较不当然等于“former price”，需看页面如何标注。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 广告中的特别声称（疗效、性能、比较、数据、统计、科研结论）须有 substantiation，并正确使用研究结果、科学术语、统计与引文；不能只判真假，只能要求证明。
rules.evidence_needed: 测试报告（方法、样本、机构、日期）、研究原文与授权、统计口径、比较基准与测试条件。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 123(a)：罚款 ₱500–₱5,000 和/或 1–6 个月监禁；行政制裁另见 Art. 164。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any advertisement which makes special claims shall: a) substantiate such claims; and b) properly use research result, scientific terms, statistics or quotations.
rules.notes: 健康/抗菌/节能类声称是最常见触发点；只写“需要证明”，不写效果真假。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 违反 Art. 110–115（广告与特别声称）的，处 ₱500–₱5,000 罚款和/或 1–6 个月监禁，由法院裁量；法人违反时，负责的经理、代表、董事、代理人或雇员承担责任。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规广告的截图/存档、投放主体、公司注册信息与责任人。
rules.penalty_or_note: 刑事罚则上限低（₱5,000），实际约束更多来自 Art. 164 行政制裁、停止令与平台下架；不要用罚金金额评估风险高低。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: any person, association, partnership or corporation who shall violate any of the provisions of Articles 110 to 115 shall, upon conviction, be subject to a fine of not less than Five Hundred Pesos (P500.00) but not more than Five thousand pesos (P5,000.00) or an imprisonment of not less than one (1) month but not more than (6) months or both upon the discretion of the court.
rules.notes: 罚则不因违规规模递增，是本市场的重要特征。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 在 PH 销售的消费品（本地制造或进口）标签/包装须标明：注册商号或品牌、注册商标、注册企业名称、制造商/进口商/重包装商在菲律宾的地址、主要成分、以公制表示的内容净量、进口商品的原产国；经许可制造的还须说明许可关系，并保证信息在正常搬运中不易擦除或脱落。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品实物标签/包装照片（六面）、进口商/重包装商名称与 PH 地址、商标注册证、净含量标示、原产国标记。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 95(a)：罚款 ₱200–₱5,000 或 1 个月–1 年监禁（非食品/化妆品/药品/器械/危险物质类）；食品等类别为 ₱500–₱20,000 或 3 个月–2 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: All consumer products domestically sold whether manufactured locally or imported shall indicate the following in their respective labels of packaging: a) its correct and registered trade name or brand name; b) its duly registered trademark; c) its duly registered business name; d) the address of the manufacturer, importer, repacker of the consumer product in the Philippines;
rules.notes: 页面通常不展示实物标签，只能写“页面未展示，需向商家索取标签照片”，不得推断未标注。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 不得展示、分销或促使在商业中分销包装或标签不符合本章规定的消费品；批发/零售分销商仅在自行包装贴标、指定包装方式或知情拒绝披露来源时落入禁止范围。
rules.evidence_needed: 标签/包装照片、包装或贴标由谁决定的合同与邮件、供货来源信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 95(a)：罚款 ₱200–₱5,000 或 1 个月–1 年监禁（非食品/化妆品/药品/器械/危险物质类）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It shall be unlawful for any person, either as principal or agent, engaged in the labeling or packaging of any consumer product, to display or distribute or to cause to be displayed or distributed in commerce any consumer product whose package or label does not conform to the provisions of this Chapter.
rules.notes: 纯转售商的责任有限；跨境品牌自营独立站通常视为自行贴标/指定标签。

rules.law_name: Department Administrative Order No. 01, Series of 2008 — Addenda to the IRR of RA 7394 on Chapter IV on Labeling and Fair Packaging 2008 年第 01 号部门行政令（标签与公平包装补充规则）
rules.requirement: 消费品标签/包装须以英文或菲语（Filipino）就产品的性质、品质、数量及其他相关信息或说明提供平行翻译，且不得使用在正常搬运中易脱落/擦除的贴纸类可移除标签（其他法规另有要求的除外）。
rules.evidence_needed: 实物标签/包装照片、原文与外文对照、贴纸类型与附着方式、进口商/经销商说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: DAO 01:2008 s.6：依 CPA 及其实施细则处理，包括扣押/检疫、原产地退运（费用由进口商承担）；CPA Art. 95 的罚则可并行适用。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: to indicate in their labels or packaging, a parallel translation in the English or Filipino language of the nature, quality and quantity and other relevant information or instructions of such consumer products in a manner that cannot be easily removed, detached or erased under ordinary handling thereof.
rules.notes: 关键含义：英文不是“随便写写即可”，外文标签必须有英文或菲语平行翻译；E-Library 文本为 OCR/转录，引文已避开识别噪声。

rules.law_name: Department Administrative Order No. 01, Series of 2008 — Addenda to the IRR of RA 7394 on Chapter IV on Labeling and Fair Packaging 2008 年第 01 号部门行政令（标签与公平包装补充规则）
rules.requirement: 标签还须标明原产国、消费期限/安全使用信息（如适用）、制造商保修、包装前重量、消费者投诉台地址，以及消费者知情权范围内的其他信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 标签照片、保修卡、投诉台地址与联系方式、包装前重量记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: DAO 01:2008 s.6：扣押/检疫、退运；CPA Art. 95(a) 罚则可并行适用。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: a. country of manufacture; b. required information of consumption duration safety (i.e.good until December 2008); c. warranty of the manufacturer; d. weight content prior to packaging; e. consumer complaint desk address;
rules.notes: “consumer complaint desk address”是跨境卖家最常缺的一项；页面上的客服链接不能替代标签上的地址。

rules.law_name: Department Administrative Order No. 01, Series of 2008 — Addenda to the IRR of RA 7394 on Chapter IV on Labeling and Fair Packaging 2008 年第 01 号部门行政令（标签与公平包装补充规则）
rules.requirement: 违反本命令的，依 CPA 及其实施细则处理，包括扣押与检疫货物、将货物退回原产国，费用由进口商承担。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规标签照片、进口记录、DTI 的扣押/检疫通知。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政处罚为主；CPA Art. 95 的刑事罚则可并行适用。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any violation of this Order shall be dealt with in accordance with the Consumer Act of the Philippines and its Implementing Rules and Regulations such as impounding and quarantine of goods and repatriation of shipment to the country of origin with cost borne by the importer.
rules.notes: 行政处罚为主；刑事罚则需与 CPA Art. 95 并行看。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 零售消费品须以价格标签/标示公开显示价格，不得高于标示价格出售，且不得对买家区别定价；商品过小或不便贴标时，可在陈列点附近放置价目表。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面价格截图（含币种与含税信息）、结算页价格、促销条件、后台价格记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 95(b)：首次违反罚款 ₱200–₱5,000 或 1–6 个月监禁；第二次定罪并吊销营业执照与许可。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It shall be unlawful to offer any consumer product for retail sale to the public without an appropriate price tag, label or marking publicly displayed to indicate the price of each article and said products shall not be sold at a price higher than that stated therein and without discrimination to all buyers
rules.notes: 线上页面同样适用；ITA s.23(a) 明确把 Art. 81 引入在线交易。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 开展销售活动（sales campaigns，含由制造企业赞助推广的全国性选美/比赛等）须在开始前至少 30 个日历日向主管机关申请许可；提交后 15 日内未收到异议或驳回，视为批准。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销活动方案与起止日期、DTI 许可/申请回执、活动规则与奖品清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 123(b)：罚款 ₱200–₱600 和/或 1–6 个月监禁；法人违反时，负责的经理/代表/董事/代理人/雇员承担责任。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall conduct any sales campaigns, including beauty contest, national in character, sponsored and promoted by manufacturing enterprises without first securing a permit from the concerned department at least thirty (30) calendar days prior to the commencement thereof.
rules.notes: 纯折扣促销是否构成“sales campaign”在实践中按 DTI 口径判断；抽奖/比赛通常需要许可，写报告时要求商家出示许可。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 不得制造、要约销售、在商业中分销或进口不符合本法所颁布适用的消费品质量或安全标准的产品。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用的 PNS 标准号、PS 许可证或 ICC 证书、测试报告、产品型号与进口记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: Art. 19(a)：罚款 ₱1,000–₱10,000 或 2 个月–1 年监禁；外国人服刑并缴罚后可被驱逐；法人负责人可同罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: manufacture for sale, offer for sale, distribute in commerce, or import into the Philippines any consumer product which is not in conformity with an applicable consumer product quality or safety standard promulgated in this Act;
rules.notes: 与 BPS 的 PS/ICC 规则配套：Art. 18 是禁止性上位条款，BPS 页面/DAO 给出具体清单与标志要求。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 7394 — The Consumer Act of the Philippines 菲律宾消费者法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 违反 Art. 18 的，处 ₱1,000–₱10,000 罚款或 2 个月–1 年监禁，或两者并罚；外国自然人服刑并缴罚后可被驱逐；法人中授权、命令或实施违规的董事/高管可同罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规产品、标准适用性证据、公司责任人信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 刑事罚则上限仍低；实际风险来自 BPS/DTI 的停止销售、扣押与召回。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who shall violate any provision of Article 18 shall upon conviction, be subject to a fine of not less than One thousand pesos (P1,000.00) but not more than Ten thousand pesos (P10,000.00) or imprisonment of not less than two (2) months but not more than one (1) year, or both upon the discretion of the court.
rules.notes: 法人负责人责任另见 Art. 19(c)；对外国法人可吊销其在 PH 的营业许可。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 4109 — Philippine Standardization Law 菲律宾标准化法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 对已依法制定并公布标准的产品，在标准经标准局（现 DTI-BPS）局长或其授权代表认证符合之前，不得以任何方式销售、处置或出口。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用标准号、PS 许可证/ICC 证书、认证范围与有效期、产品型号清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: RA 4109 s.7：6 个月–2 年监禁及 ₱1,000–₱5,000 罚款；法人违反时，知情或未阻止的董事长/董事/经理作为主犯承担责任。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: no product of the Philippines for which a standard has been established and promulgated by virtue of this Act shall be sold and/or disposed of in any manner and/or exported unless and until its standard shall have been certified by the Director of Standards or his duly authorized representatives as conforming to the standard set for, either for local distribution and/or for export
rules.notes: 1964 年法的机关名称已由后续 reorganization 变为 DTI-BPS；规则库按现行主管机关表述。

rules.law_name: DTI-BPS Mandatory Product Certification Schemes 菲律宾标准局强制产品认证计划（PS / ICC）
rules.requirement: 受强制认证覆盖的产品（本地制造或进口）在未取得 PS 标志或 ICC 前，不得在菲律宾市场分销；BPS 现行两套强制认证为 PS 质量/安全标志许可（面向工厂与产品）与 ICC 进口商品通关（面向进口商）。
rules.evidence_needed: PS 许可证号与有效期、ICC 证书号、认证覆盖的型号、进口商名称。
rules.penalty_or_note: DAO 02:2007 s.10：行政罚款 ₱500–₱150,000（消费者投诉最高 ₱300,000），另加每日不超过 ₱1,000；可并处停业、吊销/暂停许可、召回/退款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Products covered by the mandatory certification, whether locally manufactured or imported, are not allowed to be distributed in the Philippine market without the necessary PS or ICC marks.
rules.notes: 监管页面无发布/更新日期；effective_date 取抓取日，报告中只能作为监管机关口径引用。

rules.law_name: DTI-BPS List of Products Under Mandatory Certification 强制认证产品清单
rules.article: List of Products Under Mandatory Certification（web page）, HOUSEHOLD APPLIANCES items 1-21
rules.requirement: 强制认证清单“HOUSEHOLD APPLIANCES”共 21 项：电风扇、电熨斗、搅拌机、榨汁机、食物搅拌机、食物处理机、电热水壶、电饭锅、电热水瓶、咖啡机、压力锅、慢炖锅、多功能锅、烤面包机、电炉、电热板、电烤炉、电烤箱、涡轮烤炉、电磁炉、微波炉。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品类别与型号、是否落入 21 项清单、PS/ICC 证书覆盖范围。
rules.penalty_or_note: 落入清单但无 PS/ICC 的，按 PH-CERT-04 与 DAO 02:2007 处理；清单会调整，需按抓取日版本核对。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: HOUSEHOLD APPLIANCES 1. Electric fans 2. Electric irons 3. Electric blenders 4. Electric juicers 5. Electric food mixers
rules.notes: 空气炸锅、洗碗机、净水器等未出现在本版 21 项清单中；是否受其他强制标准/认证覆盖需逐 SKU 核，不得因不在清单就推断“无需认证”。

rules.law_name: DTI-BPS PS and ICC Marks 菲律宾标准标志与进口商品通关贴纸
rules.article: PS and ICC Marks（web page）, para. 1-3
rules.requirement: PS 标志或 ICC 贴纸原则上应贴在产品本体；确实不便贴附（如灯具、断路器、电线电缆等）或会损坏原包装（如电视、空调、冰箱、微波炉）时，可贴在外包装，但经销商须能提供对应包装盒/箱供 DTI 执法核对。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品本体/包装上的 PS 或 ICC 标志照片、ICC 编号、对应包装箱、进口记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 无法出示对应包装供核对的，按违规处理（BPS 页面明确）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: As a general rule, the PS mark or ICC sticker should be placed on the product itself, except in cases where affixing the mark/sticker to the product is not practicable
rules.notes: 页面照片看不到标志时只能写“页面未展示，需向商家核实”，不得推断未认证。

rules.law_name: Department Administrative Order No. 02, Series of 2007 — Defining the Responsibilities and Liabilities of Manufacturers, Importers, Traders, Wholesalers, Distributors, Retailers, Service Providers and/or Their Agents 2007 年第 02 号部门行政令（PS/ICC 相关主体责任与罚则）
rules.requirement: 进口受强制认证产品的进口商，在销售、要约销售或以其他方式处置产品前，须先取得 ICC（依 DAO 5, s. 2001 及其修订）。
rules.evidence_needed: ICC 证书号与有效期、进口商名称、对应型号/批次、进口报关记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: DAO 02:2007 s.10：行政罚款 ₱500–₱150,000（消费者投诉最高 ₱300,000），另加每日不超过 ₱1,000；可并处停业、吊销/暂停许可、召回/退款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Importers of any product covered by mandatory product certification are required to first secure an Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) pursuant to DAO 5, Series of 2001 and its future amendments or revisions prior to selling, offering for sale, or otherwise disposing of their product(s).
rules.notes: PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，引文已避开识别噪声；仍需以 PDF 图像逐字复核。

rules.law_name: Department Administrative Order No. 02, Series of 2007 — Defining the Responsibilities and Liabilities of Manufacturers, Importers, Traders, Wholesalers, Distributors, Retailers, Service Providers and/or Their Agents 2007 年第 02 号部门行政令（PS/ICC 相关主体责任与罚则）
rules.requirement: 所有标志与标记须清晰可读，且不得误导；PS/ICC 标志须按规定的样式与位置附着，并构成产品/包装的一部分，正常搬运中不易擦除或脱落。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品与包装的高清照片、标志位置与尺寸、耐久性测试或实物验证。
rules.penalty_or_note: DAO 02:2007 s.10 的行政制裁；可并处召回/退款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: All marks and markings shall be clear and legible, and must not be misleading.
rules.notes: PDF 为 OCR 文本层；引文短且清晰。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 11967 — Internet Transactions Act of 2023 2023 年互联网交易法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 在线商家/电子零售商须标明商品与服务价格，并与 CPA Art. 81 的价格标示要求一致（公开显示、不得高于标示价出售、不得区别定价）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面与结算页价格截图、币种与含税信息、促销条件、后台价格记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: ITA s.29(e)：违反 s.23(a) 的行政罚款（条文首犯/再犯档位文字有重复，见 README open questions），并可责令下架；不排除 CPA 的罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Indicate the price of goods and services offered consistent with Article 81 of Republic Act No. 7394;
rules.notes: ITA 自 2025-06-20 起结束过渡期全面执行（DTI 公告）；生效日 2023-12-20 由 18 个月过渡期倒推，未直接核对公报。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 11967 — Internet Transactions Act of 2023 2023 年互联网交易法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 在线销售的商品须随附广告/描述所载的配件、包装、安装件、用户手册或其他说明；包装上的相关信息须以菲律宾语和/或英语印刷或书写。
rules.evidence_needed: 开箱照片/视频、包装六面、用户手册语言版本、安装件清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: ITA s.29 的行政罚款清单（s.29(e)）未明确列入 s.23(c)；可依 CPA 的产品说明/标签规则与 s.29(b) 的欺诈/不公平行为路径处理，具体适用需律师确认。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Be delivered together with its accessories, including all other packaging, installation inclusions, any user manual, or other instructions as advertised or described, if applicable, with the relevant information stated in the packaging, printed or written in Filipino and/or English;
rules.notes: “Filipino and/or English”意味着英文可以，但不能只有第三种语言；与 DAO 01:2008 s.2 的平行翻译要求叠加。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 11967 — Internet Transactions Act of 2023 2023 年互联网交易法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；Official Gazette 与 DTI 站点在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 在线商家/电子零售商通过互联网实施欺骗、不公平或显失公平的销售行为，除 CPA 的罚则外，另处行政罚款：首犯 ₱20,000–₱100,000；再犯 ₱100,000–₱500,000；第三次及以后 ₱500,000–₱1,000,000。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规页面与交易记录、DTI 处罚/下架通知、前案记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 可并责令下架（takedown）；不影响其他法律下的民事/刑事责任。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An online merchant or e-retailer found guilty of any deceptive, unfair or unconscionable sales act or practice, done through the internet, shall be, in addition to the penalties imposed under Republic Act No. 7394, punished with:
rules.notes: 这是 PH 对线上虚假宣传最直接、金额最高的行政罚则路径之一。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012 2012 年数据隐私法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；NPC 官网 privacy.gov.ph 在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 处理个人信息须遵守透明、正当目的与比例原则；处理前须声明特定、正当的目的，并以公平、正当方式进行，收集范围不得超出目的所需。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策/收集告知文本、收集表单与勾选项、收集目的说明、数据流与共享清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 DPA 的刑事责任见 Sec. 25（未授权处理：1–3 年 + ₱500,000–₱2,000,000）；NPC 另有行政罚款与整改令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The processing of personal information shall be allowed, subject to compliance with the requirements of this Act and other laws allowing disclosure of information to the public and adherence to the principles of transparency, legitimate purpose and proportionality.
rules.notes: “透明”在执法中落到收集时的告知；只检查页面是否有隐私政策链接不够。NPC 的 IRR/通告未取得（站点 403），本版只用法条。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012 2012 年数据隐私法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；NPC 官网 privacy.gov.ph 在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 数据主体有权在个人信息进入处理系统前（或最近可行时点）获知：信息描述、处理目的、处理范围与方法、接收方类别、自动化访问方式、控制者身份与联系方式、保存期限，以及访问/更正/投诉权利；告知内容变更须事先通知。
rules.evidence_needed: 收集点的隐私告知全文、表单字段与目的对应关系、保存期限政策、接收方/共享清单、权利行使渠道。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未履行告知/透明义务可能构成 Sec. 25 的未授权处理或 NPC 行政违规；具体定性需律师判断。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Be furnished the information indicated hereunder before the entry of his or her personal information into the processing system of the personal information controller, or at the next practical opportunity:
rules.notes: 条文本身没有“privacy notice”字样；报告应写“依 Sec. 16(b) 的知情权”，不要虚构“隐私通知条款”。

rules.law_name: Republic Act No. 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012 2012 年数据隐私法
rules.official_url_note: Lawphil（Arellano Law Foundation）全文镜像；NPC 官网 privacy.gov.ph 在本环境返回 HTTP 403。
rules.requirement: 未经数据主体同意、且无本法或其他法律授权而处理个人信息的，处 1–3 年监禁及 ₱500,000–₱2,000,000 罚款；处理敏感个人信息（含健康、生物识别等）的，处 3–6 年及 ₱500,000–₱4,000,000。
rules.evidence_needed: 同意记录、处理目的与法律依据、数据清单（是否含敏感信息）、事件时间线。
rules.penalty_or_note: 法人违反时，依 Sec. 34 由负责的董事/高管承担责任；另有 NPC 行政罚款与整改令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The unauthorized processing of personal information shall be penalized by imprisonment ranging from one (1) year to three (3) years and a fine of not less than Five hundred thousand pesos (Php500,000.00) but not more than Two million pesos (Php2,000,000.00)
rules.notes: 罚则金额显著高于 CPA；隐私类 finding 的风险权重应高于广告类。
